name: Kurokami JK-san! Ore o Uketomete Kudasai ><
original_name: 黒髪JKさん！俺を受け止めて下さい＞＜
source:
Be pampered and in return pamper a JK.

"Sensei, release your desires. All of them. We will set you free."

The embarrassment... the humiliation... the thrill and pleasure is real.
Am I perhaps... a total masochist...!?
